findings.evidence: All decrement buttons on the cart strip carry an incomplete aria-label. Five .kiosk-cart-strip-btn--minus buttons read aria-label="Supprimer du panier" (no item name) and one reads aria-label="Retirer un" (sentence truncated mid-string, no item name). All increment buttons (.kiosk-cart-strip-btn--plus) read aria-label="Ajouter un" (truncated mid-string, no item name). These are icon-only +/- buttons, so a screen-reader user navigating the 7-article cart hears five identical 'Supprimer du panier' and seven 'Ajouter un' with no way to distinguish which line (Glace / Tarte Daim / Tiramisu / Coca-Cola 33cl / Fromage supplémentaire) is being acted on.
findings.fix_hint: resources/js/components/frontend/kiosk/CartBottomSheetComponent.vue (or KioskCartStripComponent.vue, data-v-01b8ee94 scope) — change aria-label bindings to template-literals that interpolate item.name, e.g. :aria-label="$t('kiosk.cart.add_one', { item: item.name })" and :aria-label="$t('kiosk.cart.remove_one', { item: item.name })". Add missing FR/EN/AR keys in lang/*/kiosk.php. Also normalise the inconsistent minus label ('Supprimer du panier' vs 'Retirer un') to a single key.

findings.evidence: Cart strip items use .kiosk-cart-strip-name { font-size: 13px; font-weight: 700; overflow: hidden; text-overflow: ellipsis; white-space: nowrap; } inside a 280px-wide horizontal card and have no title attribute. Visible result in PNG: 'Coca-Cola 33cl' renders as 'Coca Co...', 'Fromage à raclette' / 'Fromage supplémentaire' renders as 'Fromage à...' / 'Fromage ...'. DOM grep for title attr on .kiosk-cart-strip-name returns 0 matches across all 7 strip items, so hover/touch users cannot recover the full name.
findings.fix_hint: Same component as D-001 — add :title="item.name" on the .kiosk-cart-strip-name element so the full label is available via tooltip and accessible name. Alternative: widen the strip card to 320px (still fits 3+ items in viewport) or wrap on two lines with -webkit-line-clamp: 2.

findings.evidence: State filename promises an expanded bottom-sheet view ('09-d-bottom-sheet-after-mixed-cart') but the captured PNG and DOM are identical to state 10 (same Suppléments grid, same docked cart strip, same '7 articles' count, same 16,90€ total). md5 differs (52945388 vs 275b6448) only because of timestamp/dynamic data; visually they are the same surface. There is no '.kiosk-cart-bottom-sheet' element with an open/expanded class anywhere in 09-d DOM — only the docked .kiosk-cart-strip is rendered. The spec did not actually open the bottom-sheet overlay; coverage of the expanded sheet (full item list, sticky checkout, line edit controls) is missing for Wave D.
findings.fix_hint: tests/e2e/test-e2e-borne-D.spec.ts — add an explicit await page.getByTestId('kiosk-bottom-cart').click() (or equivalent click on '.kiosk-bottom-cart' / aria-label='Ouvrir le panier') before capturing state 09, then wait for the expanded sheet selector (likely [data-state="open"] or .kiosk-cart-bottom-sheet--open) before screenshot. Without this, the 'bottom-sheet' name in the artifact is misleading and the Phase A coverage matrix has a gap.

findings.evidence: On all three category pages (Desserts 316, Boissons 317, Suppléments 318) most product cards display a generic rounded-square light-grey placeholder with a '+' icon instead of a product photo (e.g. Tarte Daim, Capri-Sun, Coca-Cola Zero 33cl, Oasis Tropical 33cl, Sauce Supplémentaire, Boursin, Fromage à raclette, Fromage supplémentaire, Galette pommes de terre, Jambon de Dinde). Only Glace, Coca-Cola 33cl, Fanta Orange, Eau Plate, Tiramisu, Sprite have real product imagery. The placeholder gives no indication that it is a 'no-photo' fallback (no caption such as 'Photo bientôt disponible'); customers may read the giant '+' as 'tap here to add' confusion overlay rather than a missing-image state.
findings.fix_hint: Either (a) backfill product photos in storage/app/public/products/ for the listed items, or (b) update the no-image placeholder template (likely resources/js/components/frontend/kiosk/KioskCategoriesComponent.vue product-card slot) to render an explicit visual fallback with an icon + 'Photo à venir' caption rather than the empty '+' tile that mimics an action affordance.

findings.evidence: Currency formatting on price chips is inconsistent with the rest of the FR locale. Strip price renders as '€3,80' / '€4,50' (prefix, no space) and category card prices render as '€5,80' / '€1,00' (prefix). The bottom-right cart-total CTA, however, renders '€16,90' as a prefix too. French AFNOR / NF Z11-013 convention is suffix with NBSP: '3,80 €'. The aria-label 'Ouvrir le panier — N articles' uses NBSP correctly so the i18n layer supports it. This is cosmetic only (no key leak, no broken plural), but it visibly drifts from the rest of FoodKing's POS/OSS surfaces which use suffix euros.
findings.fix_hint: resources/js/utils/format.js (or wherever the kiosk price formatter lives) — switch the price formatter to Intl.NumberFormat('fr-FR', { style: 'currency', currency: 'EUR' }).format(value) which emits '3,80 €' with the correct NBSP. Audit all .kiosk-cart-strip-price, .kiosk-card-price and the strip-total CTA template.

Five findings remain: D-001 P1 (broken aria-label on +/- buttons — blocks AMBER→GREEN), D-002 P2 truncation without title, D-003 P2 audit-integrity gap (bottom-sheet state never actually expanded by spec), D-004 P2 weak no-image placeholder, D-005 P3 currency-formatter drift. Verdict AMBER (open_P0=0, open_P1=1).
